d: Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

d: Role Description This part-time remote Purchase Specialist role at Asociación Saray - Asociación Navarra de Cáncer de Mama focuses on supporting procurement activities that contribute to the organization’s mission. The Purchase Specialist reviews requests, prepares and processes purchase orders, and ensures that purchases comply with internal guidelines and budget constraints. Responsibilities include identifying suppliers, requesting quotes, comparing offers, and negotiating basic terms to secure cost-effective and timely procurement of goods and services. The role involves maintaining accurate purchasing records, tracking deliveries, resolving order discrepancies, and collaborating with finance and program teams to ensure alignment with project needs. The Purchase Specialist also supports continuous improvement of purchasing processes by monitoring performance, analyzing spending data, and suggesting optimization opportunities.
q: Ability to manage purchasing activities, including Purchasing Processes and Purchase Management, and ensure compliance with organizational policies.
Experience creating, reviewing, and tracking Purchase Orders and handling end-to-end Purchasing tasks.
Strong Analytical Skills to evaluate supplier proposals, compare costs, and support data-driven purchasing decisions.
Basic knowledge of procurement or supply chain principles and familiarity with budgeting or financial controls.
Proficiency with office and collaboration tools (e.g., spreadsheets, online procurement platforms, email, videoconferencing).
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple requests in a remote, part-time environment.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with internal teams and external vendors.
Previous experience in purchasing, administration, or non-profit operations is an advantage; vocational training or a degree in business, administration, or a related field is beneficial.
